description: LINK-SESSION with an own source and two Workspaces: the default Workspace and a second Workspace (CreateWorkspace, dbUseJet) each open the host; the first begins a transaction and inserts through LK; the second reads LK and tries its own insert (marker and Errors around it); the first rolls back, then repeats with a commit; run with IsolateODBCTrans 0 and then 1 on the first Workspace. Asks whether one Workspace's link transaction affects the other.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
